placements.title: Calibrating what should and should not be selected
placements.frame: What signals determine whether an artifact merits selection or rejection?
placements.why: The title 'Some Other Title That Should Not Win' declares an artifact unworthy of selection, naming an organizational category about calibrating review decisions that nothing existing covers.

placements.title: Titles that declare their own disqualification from selection
placements.frame: How does a title that names itself as undeserving function as a calibration signal in review?
placements.why: The title 'Some Other Title That Should Not Win' is a self-disqualifying declaration in a review context — it names a theme about titles that signal their own unworthiness, which future envelopes in review evaluation could feed.
